// why this file exists: A shared list of suite qualifiers, in the shape a repository passes to no-self-mock-sut: the trailing name segments a colocated suite may carry that are stripped to find its subject (`foo.integration.test.ts` tests `foo.ts`). A mutation gate deriving a suite's subject can read the same list, so the two cannot drift apart.

`stateMatrix` alone may carry one area segment matching `stateMatrixArea` (`ProductsPage.states.loading.test.tsx`). `notQualifiers` are the near-misses that stay out: `usecase` is a source suffix, `meta` names a suite that tests the property suites.
